review_time_definition: Wall-clock from first detailed inspection to submission; includes coordination/tool delays, not independent human labor.

anchors.quote: Conditionally represent each execution of pivot selection as a one-hot QUBO over row indices col through n-1. The objective must select the greatest absolute current pivot and resolve exact ties in favor of the lowest index. The one-hot constraint and lexicographic objective require coefficients and penalties proven sufficient for every permitted state. Only kernel.py line 13 is replaced; singularity checking, swapping, elimination, back substitution, diagnostics, and report construction remain classical.

Encode the dynamically modified values rows[i][col], together with eligible row indices, using one selection bit per candidate row. The encoding must reproduce Python binary64 absolute-value ordering, equality, signed-zero behavior, and first-index tie resolution. Exact coefficient construction, representation of states containing nonfinite intermediate values, coherent or repeated state loading, and penalty bounds that preserve the lexicographic optimum are unresolved.

Decode a one-hot selected row and verify classically that it is exactly the first index attaining Python's maximum absolute pivot value. Invalid, infeasible, suboptimal, or uncertified samples cannot be accepted. A semantics-preserving implementation must fall back to the classical selection or otherwise provide an exact failure policy before executing the unchanged zero-pivot check and swap.

The eligible row indices form a finite domain, and a predicate identifying the first maximum could be defined. However, evaluating that predicate requires exact comparisons against every competing current pivot plus exact tie handling. No reversible predicate construction, coherent data-access mechanism, resource bound, or deterministic error policy is supplied, so applicability is unresolved.

binding.rationale: The self-review retains an unconstructed one-hot QUBO with unresolved coefficients, penalty bounds and exceptional-state ordering. It supplies no explicit secondary pivot selector. Preserve the supported alternative family as an unverified conditional plan rather than inventing a Boolean relation or counting fallback language as correctness. No concrete local rule is available to this checker.
